Let's make good happen.

Leadership, fundraising, communications and advocacy support for charities.

Make Good Happen offers Leadership and Engagement support for charities. We give executive counsel to the people leading charities, and we help charities engage the outside world through fundraising, communications and advocacy. We run entire fundraising functions and give advice and strategic support to executive teams, from hands-on delivery to strategy.

What we do

Fundraising

Raising more, for longer. Fundraising strategy, consultancy and hands-on delivery for charities.

Comms and advocacy

Getting your cause heard by supporters, the media and decision-makers.

Leadership

Consultancy support for charity CEOs and executives, and support for founders.

How we work

However you need us, across everything we do: strategy, consultancy and hands-on delivery.
